# Introduction

The objective of this notebook is to analyse the mIF data for FAP and CNN1 staining localisation

## Load packages

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(broom)
library(emmeans)
library(rstatix)
```

## Parameters

```{r}
# Paths
output_path <- "../03_output/02_FAPI_statistics/"
if(!dir.exists(output_path)) dir.create(output_path)

# Functions
source("../../utils.R")
```

```{r}
df_FAPI_data <- FAPI_data %>%
  mutate(
    Disease_Severity = factor(
      Disease_Severity,
      levels = c("Control", "Sclerosis", "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    Sex_male = as.numeric(Sex == "Male"),
    Hypertension = factor(Hypertension),
    Hypertension_Yes = as.numeric(Hypertension == "Yes"),
    Diabetes = factor(Diabetes),
    Diabetes_Yes = as.numeric(Diabetes == "Yes"),
    Calcific_Volume_log1p = log1p(Calcific_Volume),
    CT_Calcium_Score_log1p = log1p(CT_Calcium_Score),
    Age_at_Consent_z = scale(Age_at_Consent)[,1],
    Calcific_z       = scale(Calcific_Volume_log1p)[,1],
    Non_Calcific_z   = scale(Non_Calcific_Volume)[,1],
    log_TBRmax       = log(TBRmax)
  )

df_FAPI_data_autoplaq <- df_FAPI_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Calcific_Volume))
```

```{r}
df_trend <- df_FAPI_data %>%
  mutate(severity_score = as.numeric(Disease_Severity) - 1)

fit_trend <- lm(TBRmax ~ severity_score, data = df_trend)
summary(fit_trend)
tidy_model <- function(fit) broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE)

tbl_trend <- tidy_model(fit_trend)

write.csv(tbl_trend, file = paste0(output_path, "Figure_3c_ASdiagnosis_FAPI_trend_stats.csv"), row.names = F)
```


```{r}
ct <- cor.test(df_FAPI_data$AVE_AV_Vmax,
               df_FAPI_data$TBRmax,
               method = "pearson")
cor_table <- data.frame(
  Method      = ct$method,
  Correlation = ct$estimate,
  CI_lower    = ct$conf.int[1],
  CI_upper    = ct$conf.int[2],
  p_value     = ct$p.value,
  n           = ct$parameter + 2 
)

cor_table
write.csv(x = cor_table, paste0(output_path, "Figure_3e_Vmax_TBRmax_correlation.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

ct <- cor.test(
  df_FAPI_data$TBRmax,
  df_FAPI_data$CT_Calcium_Score_log1p,
  method = "pearson"
)
cor_table <- data.frame(
  Method      = ct$method,
  Correlation = ct$estimate,
  CI_lower    = ct$conf.int[1],
  CI_upper    = ct$conf.int[2],
  p_value     = ct$p.value,
  n           = ct$parameter + 2 
)

cor_table
write.csv(x = cor_table, paste0(output_path, "Figure_3d_CTcalcium_TBRmax_correlation.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)


ct <- cor.test(
  df_FAPI_data_autoplaq$Non_Calcific_Volume,
  df_FAPI_data_autoplaq$TBRmax,
  method = "pearson"
)
cor_table <- data.frame(
  Method      = ct$method,
  Correlation = ct$estimate,
  CI_lower    = ct$conf.int[1],
  CI_upper    = ct$conf.int[2],
  p_value     = ct$p.value,
  n           = ct$parameter + 2  # df = n-2 for Pearson
)

cor_table
write.csv(x = cor_table, paste0(output_path, "Figure_3f_NonCalcificThickening_TBRmax_correlation.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

ct <- cor.test(
  df_FAPI_data_autoplaq$Calcific_Volume_log1p,
  df_FAPI_data_autoplaq$TBRmax,
  method = "pearson"
)
cor_table <- data.frame(
  Method      = ct$method,
  Correlation = ct$estimate,
  CI_lower    = ct$conf.int[1],
  CI_upper    = ct$conf.int[2],
  p_value     = ct$p.value,
  n           = ct$parameter + 2  # df = n-2 for Pearson
)

cor_table
write.csv(x = cor_table, paste0(output_path, "Figure_3g_CalcificThickening_TBRmax_correlation.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
fit <- lm(log_TBRmax ~ Age_at_Consent_z + Sex_male + Hypertension_Yes + 
          Diabetes_Yes + Calcific_z + Non_Calcific_z, 
          data = df_FAPI_data_autoplaq)
summary(fit)
```

```{r}
# Visual
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(fit)

# Formal tests
shapiro.test(resid(fit))           # normality
library(car)
vif(fit)                           # collinearity
library(lmtest)
bptest(fit)                        # heteroscedasticity
```

```{r}
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
robust <- coeftest(fit, vcov = vcovHC(fit, type = "HC3"))
robust
```
```{r}
robust_tidy <- broom::tidy(robust, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      term == "Age_at_Consent_z" ~ "Age",
      term == "Sex_male"         ~ "Male sex",
      term == "Hypertension_Yes" ~ "Hypertension",
      term == "Diabetes_Yes"     ~ "Diabetes",
      term == "Calcific_z"       ~ "Calcific volume",
      term == "Non_Calcific_z"   ~ "Non-calcific volume"
    ),
    `β (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f to %.3f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    P = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001", TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
  )

# Final table
robust_tidy %>% select(label, `β (95% CI)`, P)

cat(sprintf(
  "n = %d; Adjusted R² = %.3f; F-test P = %.2e; all VIF < %.1f\nOutcome: log(TBRmax). Calcific and non-calcific volumes log-transformed prior to standardisation. HC3 robust standard errors.",
  nobs(fit),
  summary(fit)$adj.r.squared,
  pf(summary(fit)$fstatistic[1], summary(fit)$fstatistic[2],
     summary(fit)$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE),
  max(vif(fit))
))
```

```{r}
library(openxlsx)
# Build the table
tbl_out <- robust_tidy %>% select(label, `β (95% CI)`, P)

# Build the footnote
footnote <- sprintf(
  "n = %d; Adjusted R² = %.3f; F-test P = %.2e; all VIF < %.1f. Outcome: log(TBRmax). Calcific volume log-transformed prior to standardisation. HC3 robust standard errors.",
  nobs(fit),
  summary(fit)$adj.r.squared,
  pf(summary(fit)$fstatistic[1], summary(fit)$fstatistic[2],
     summary(fit)$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE),
  max(vif(fit))
)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "MVA")
writeData(wb, "MVA", tbl_out)
writeData(wb, "MVA", footnote, startRow = nrow(tbl_out) + 2, startCol = 1)

# Style the footnote row
addStyle(wb, "MVA",
         style = createStyle(fontSize = 9, textDecoration = "italic"),
         rows = nrow(tbl_out) + 2, cols = 1)

saveWorkbook(wb, paste0(output_path, "Supplemental_Table_7_TBRmax_MVA.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
